title: Reduced‑Calorie, High‑Fiber Bread, White or NFS, with Fruit and Nuts

content.title: About
content.content: This bread is made from whole‑grain flour enriched with bran and psyllium to boost dietary fiber and lower calorie density. Dried fruits (raisins, apricots) and nuts (walnuts, almonds) are added for natural sweetness and crunch. It is available in a classic white version and a gluten‑free (NFS) version.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Fiber content is almost double that of regular white bread.
Dried fruits retain most B‑vitamins and antioxidants.
Nuts increase the amount of heart‑healthy monounsaturated fats.
The gluten‑free version uses rice and corn flours.
Lower moisture gives the loaf a longer shelf life.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: High levels of soluble and insoluble fiber promote regular bowel movements and gut health.

items.title: Reduced calorie intake
items.content: With added bran and psyllium, the loaf provides only about 180 kcal per 100 g, making it suitable for weight‑management diets.

items.title: Blood‑sugar stability
items.content: Fiber slows glucose absorption, helping maintain steady blood‑sugar levels.

items.title: Rich in vitamins and minerals
items.content: Dried fruits and nuts supply vitamin E, potassium, magnesium, and iron.

items.title: Cardiovascular support
items.content: Monounsaturated fats from nuts help lower LDL cholesterol.

items.title: Nut allergy
items.content: The product contains walnuts and almonds, which may trigger allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Natural sugars from dried fruit
items.content: Although low in calories, dried fruits add natural sugars; people with diabetes should monitor portion size.

items.title: Gluten in the white version
items.content: The regular white loaf contains wheat; those with celiac disease should choose the gluten‑free version.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The bread works well toasted, as a base for sandwiches, or alongside soups and salads. Slice thinly and toast to highlight the nut crunch. Pair with low‑fat cottage cheese or avocado for a balanced snack.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the loaf in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 5 days. For longer storage (up to 2 weeks) refrigerate. Freezing preserves quality for up to 3 months.
